<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ImputazioneCosti\Tables;

use App\Enums\Organization;
use App\Enums\TipoImputazione;
use App\Filament\Resources\ImputazioneCosti\Schemas\ImputazioneCostForm;
use App\Models\ImputazioneCost;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Support\Enums\Width;
use Filament\Support\Icons\Heroicon;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Table;

class ImputazioneCostiTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('mese')
                    ->label('Mese')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (int $state): string => \Carbon\Carbon::create()->month($state)->translatedFormat('F')),
                TextColumn::make('anno')
                    ->label('Anno')
                    ->sortable(),
                TextColumn::make('organization')
                    ->label('Organizzazione')
                    ->badge(),
                TextColumn::make('tipo')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->badge(),
                TextColumn::make('fattore')
                    ->label('Fattore')
                    ->numeric(2),
            ])
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make('organization')
                    ->label('Organizzazione')
                    ->options(
                        collect(Organization::cases())
                            ->reject(fn (Organization $org) => $org === Organization::RETE)
                            ->mapWithKeys(fn (Organization $org) => [$org->value => $org->getLabel()])
                            ->toArray()
                    ),
                SelectFilter::make('tipo')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->options(TipoImputazione::class),
                
            ])
            ->recordActions([
                EditAction::make()
                    ->slideOver()
                    ->modalWidth(Width::ScreenTwoExtraLarge),
                Action::make('duplicate')
                    ->label('Duplica')
                    ->icon(Heroicon::OutlinedDocumentDuplicate)
                    ->color('gray')
                    ->fillForm(fn (ImputazioneCost $record): array => $record->only([
                        'mese',
                        'anno',
                        'organization',
                        'tipo',
                        'fattore',
                    ]))
                    ->schema(ImputazioneCostForm::schema())
                    ->action(fn (array $data) => ImputazioneCost::create($data)),
            ])
            ->paginationPageOptions([25,50,100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(100)
            ->defaultSort('anno', 'desc')
            ->defaultSort('mese', 'desc');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\CostEntries\Tables;

use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use App\Enums\DocumentType;
use App\Enums\Organization;
use App\Models\CostEntry;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Support\Enums\Width;
use Filament\Tables\Enums\FiltersLayout;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Filter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Indicator;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class CostEntriesTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('supplier')
                    ->label('Cedente / Prestatore')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->wrap(),
                TextColumn::make('sdi_id')
                    ->label('ID SDI')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->toggleable(),
                TextColumn::make('document_number')
                    ->label('N° doc.')
                    ->searchable(),
                TextColumn::make('document_type')
                    ->label('Tipo doc.')
                    ->badge()
                    ->searchable(),
                TextColumn::make('document_date')
                    ->label('Data doc.')
                    ->date('d/m/Y')
                    ->sortable(),
                TextColumn::make('amount')
                    ->label('Importo')
                    ->money('EUR', locale: 'it')
                    ->color(fn ($state) => ((float) $state) < 0 ? 'danger' : null)
                    ->sortable()
                    ->alignEnd(),
                TextColumn::make('expense_category')
                    ->label('Categoria')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->wrap(),
                TextColumn::make('organization')
                    ->label('Org.')
                    ->badge()
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable(),
                TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Importato il')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(isToggledHiddenByDefault: true),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('document_date', 'desc')
            ->filters([
                Filter::make('document_date_range')
                    ->label('Periodo')
                    ->schema([
                        DatePicker::make('from')
                            ->label('Dal')
                            ->native(false)
                            ->displayFormat('d/m/Y'),
                        DatePicker::make('to')
                            ->label('Al')
                            ->native(false)
                            ->displayFormat('d/m/Y'),
                    ])
                    ->query(function (Builder $query, array $data): Builder {
                        return $query
                            ->when(
                                $data['from'] ?? null,
                                fn (Builder $q, $date) => $q->whereDate('document_date', '>=', $date),
                            )
                            ->when(
                                $data['to'] ?? null,
                                fn (Builder $q, $date) => $q->whereDate('document_date', '<=', $date),
                            );
                    })
                    ->indicateUsing(function (array $data): array {
                        $indicators = [];

                        if ($data['from'] ?? null) {
                            $indicators[] = Indicator::make('Dal ' . \Carbon\Carbon::parse($data['from'])->format('d/m/Y'))
                                ->removeField('from');
                        }

                        if ($data['to'] ?? null) {
                            $indicators[] = Indicator::make('Al ' . \Carbon\Carbon::parse($data['to'])->format('d/m/Y'))
                                ->removeField('to');
                        }

                        return $indicators;
                    }),
                SelectFilter::make('organization')
                    ->label('Organizzazione')
                    ->options(Organization::class)
                    ->multiple(),
                SelectFilter::make('document_type')
                    ->label('Tipo documento')
                    ->options(DocumentType::class)
                    ->multiple(),
                SelectFilter::make('expense_category')
                    ->label('Categoria')
                    ->multiple()
                    ->options(fn () => CostEntry::query()
                        ->whereNotNull('expense_category')
                        ->distinct()
                        ->orderBy('expense_category')
                        ->pluck('expense_category', 'expense_category')
                        ->all()),
            ])
            ->filtersLayout(FiltersLayout::Modal)
            ->filtersFormWidth(Width::Full)
            ->filtersFormColumns(4)
            ->recordActions([
                EditAction::make()
                    ->slideOver()
                    ->modalWidth(Width::ScreenTwoExtraLarge),
            ])
            ->paginationPageOptions([25,50,100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(100)
            ->toolbarActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\ImputazioneCosti\Tables;

use App\Enums\Organization;
use App\Enums\TipoImputazione;
use App\Filament\Resources\ImputazioneCosti\Schemas\ImputazioneCostForm;
use App\Models\ImputazioneCost;
use Filament\Actions\Action;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use Filament\Support\Enums\Width;
use Filament\Support\Icons\Heroicon;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Table;

class ImputazioneCostiTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('mese')
                    ->label('Mese')
                    ->formatStateUsing(fn (int $state): string => \Carbon\Carbon::create()->month($state)->translatedFormat('F')),
                TextColumn::make('anno')
                    ->label('Anno')
                    ->sortable(),
                TextColumn::make('organization')
                    ->label('Organizzazione')
                    ->badge(),
                TextColumn::make('tipo')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->badge(),
                TextColumn::make('fattore')
                    ->label('Fattore')
                    ->numeric(2),
            ])
            ->filters([
                SelectFilter::make('anno')
                    ->label('Anno')
                    ->options(fn () => ImputazioneCost::query()
                        ->distinct()
                        ->orderByDesc('anno')
                        ->pluck('anno', 'anno')
                        ->all()),
                SelectFilter::make('organization')
                    ->label('Organizzazione')
                    ->options(
                        collect(Organization::cases())
                            ->reject(fn (Organization $org) => $org === Organization::RETE)
                            ->mapWithKeys(fn (Organization $org) => [$org->value => $org->getLabel()])
                            ->toArray()
                    ),
                SelectFilter::make('tipo')
                    ->label('Tipo')
                    ->options(TipoImputazione::class),
                
            ])
            ->recordActions([
                EditAction::make()
                    ->slideOver()
                    ->modalWidth(Width::ScreenTwoExtraLarge),
                Action::make('duplicate')
                    ->label('Duplica')
                    ->icon(Heroicon::OutlinedDocumentDuplicate)
                    ->color('gray')
                    ->fillForm(fn (ImputazioneCost $record): array => $record->only([
                        'mese',
                        'anno',
                        'organization',
                        'tipo',
                        'fattore',
                    ]))
                    ->schema(ImputazioneCostForm::schema())
                    ->action(fn (array $data) => ImputazioneCost::create($data)),
            ])
            ->paginationPageOptions([25,50,100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(100)
            ->defaultSort('anno', 'desc')
            ->defaultSort('mese', 'desc');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Filament\Resources\CostEntries\Tables;

use Filament\Actions\BulkActionGroup;
use Filament\Actions\DeleteBulkAction;
use Filament\Actions\EditAction;
use App\Enums\DocumentType;
use App\Enums\Organization;
use App\Models\CostEntry;
use Filament\Forms\Components\DatePicker;
use Filament\Support\Enums\Width;
use Filament\Tables\Enums\FiltersLayout;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Filter;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\Indicator;
use Filament\Tables\Filters\SelectFilter;
use Filament\Tables\Columns\TextColumn;
use Filament\Tables\Table;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;

class CostEntriesTable
{
    public static function configure(Table $table): Table
    {
        return $table
            ->columns([
                TextColumn::make('supplier')
                    ->label('Cedente / Prestatore')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->wrap(),
                TextColumn::make('sdi_id')
                    ->label('ID SDI')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->toggleable(),
                TextColumn::make('document_number')
                    ->label('N° doc.')
                    ->searchable(),
                TextColumn::make('document_type')
                    ->label('Tipo doc.')
                    ->badge()
                    ->searchable(),
                TextColumn::make('document_date')
                    ->label('Data doc.')
                    ->date('d/m/Y')
                    ->sortable(),
                TextColumn::make('amount')
                    ->label('Importo')
                    ->money('EUR', locale: 'it')
                    ->color(fn ($state) => ((float) $state) < 0 ? 'danger' : null)
                    ->sortable()
                    ->alignEnd(),
                TextColumn::make('expense_category')
                    ->label('Categoria')
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable()
                    ->wrap(),
                TextColumn::make('organization')
                    ->label('Org.')
                    ->badge()
                    ->searchable()
                    ->sortable(),
                TextColumn::make('created_at')
                    ->label('Importato il')
                    ->dateTime('d/m/Y H:i')
                    ->sortable()
                    ->toggleable(isToggledHiddenByDefault: true),
            ])
            ->defaultSort('document_date', 'desc')
            ->filters([
                Filter::make('document_date_range')
                    ->label('Periodo')
                    ->schema([
                        DatePicker::make('from')
                            ->label('Dal')
                            ->native(false)
                            ->displayFormat('d/m/Y'),
                        DatePicker::make('to')
                            ->label('Al')
                            ->native(false)
                            ->displayFormat('d/m/Y'),
                    ])
                    ->query(function (Builder $query, array $data): Builder {
                        return $query
                            ->when(
                                $data['from'] ?? null,
                                fn (Builder $q, $date) => $q->whereDate('document_date', '>=', $date),
                            )
                            ->when(
                                $data['to'] ?? null,
                                fn (Builder $q, $date) => $q->whereDate('document_date', '<=', $date),
                            );
                    })
                    ->indicateUsing(function (array $data): array {
                        $indicators = [];

                        if ($data['from'] ?? null) {
                            $indicators[] = Indicator::make('Dal ' . \Carbon\Carbon::parse($data['from'])->format('d/m/Y'))
                                ->removeField('from');
                        }

                        if ($data['to'] ?? null) {
                            $indicators[] = Indicator::make('Al ' . \Carbon\Carbon::parse($data['to'])->format('d/m/Y'))
                                ->removeField('to');
                        }

                        return $indicators;
                    }),
                SelectFilter::make('organization')
                    ->label('Organizzazione')
                    ->options(Organization::class)
                    ->multiple(),
                SelectFilter::make('document_type')
                    ->label('Tipo documento')
                    ->options(DocumentType::class)
                    ->multiple(),
                SelectFilter::make('expense_category')
                    ->label('Categoria')
                    ->multiple()
                    ->options(fn () => CostEntry::query()
                        ->whereNotNull('expense_category')
                        ->distinct()
                        ->orderBy('expense_category')
                        ->pluck('expense_category', 'expense_category')
                        ->all()),
            ])
            ->filtersLayout(FiltersLayout::Modal)
            ->filtersFormWidth(Width::Full)
            ->filtersFormColumns(4)
            ->recordActions([
                EditAction::make()
                    ->slideOver()
                    ->modalWidth(Width::ScreenTwoExtraLarge),
            ])
            ->paginationPageOptions([25,50,100])
            ->defaultPaginationPageOption(100)
            ->toolbarActions([
                BulkActionGroup::make([
                    DeleteBulkAction::make(),
                ]),
            ]);
    }
}
